text:
Dina: Starting thread for AuroraBank POC — they want a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Requirements: header passthrough, streaming parity, identical usage numbers for pilot, KMS for customer keys, and mTLS for pilot. Who can take which action?

Omar: I will own POC plan and pricing. Quick ask: do we have an example CompetitorX request/stream frames and non-stream response? Need to scope mapping.

Dina: Example pasted below. Note CompetitorX sends header X-CX-Tenant and includes deterministic_seed + choice_flags. Streaming frames are newline-delimited JSON with "delta" fields.

Liam: Engineering note: we don't currently emit deterministic_seed or choice_flags. Token counts differ due to newline tokenization. We can add a lightweight proxy layer to synthesize fields and normalize tokenization. Estimate: 2 engineers, 3 days to feature flag it.

Teja: Security checklist: KMS-managed keys, audit logs (90d), IP allowlist, idempotency-key support, SOC2 artifacts, and mTLS for pilot. I'll take the questionnaire. Need KMS alias and expected grant model.

Omar: POC scope suggestion: 1) passthrough X-CX-Tenant 2) preserve trace_id in response header 3) synthesize deterministic_seed using stable hash(prompt) 4) map our annotations -> choice_flags 5) run normalization step for token counting. Feature toggle: cx_compat_mode.

Liam: Streaming mapping plan: translate CompetitorX frames {"delta":"text"} into Redwood events {event: 'content', data: 'text'}. We'll also emit a header X-Orig-Trace with incoming trace_id. Normalization: collapse triple-newlines to double-newlines; toggleable. Perf hit minimal.

deploy-bot: Staging: vpc-poc-15 provisioned. KMS key alias cx-poc-2026 created and granted to eng-team principal. Temporary creds will be posted to #secure-staging in ~90m.

Omar: Pricing: propose 300k normalized-token credit for pilot + 25% pilot discount for first month. Bill on normalized tokens during pilot; reconcile on contract. I'll draft a one-pager.

Teja: mTLS is a potential blocker for hosted mode. If customer requires client cert verification per tenant we may need Dedicated. Please confirm exact mTLS expectations (client cert CA, rotation, cert TTL).

Dina: Teja, flag mTLS in the risk section and escalate if Dedicated fallback needed. Omar, include Dedicated delta in cost doc. Liam, please gate implementation behind cx_compat_mode flag.

Liam: Will do. I'll open PR once staging creds arrive and include the streaming mapping + normalization behind feature flag. Will also add a small synthesizer for deterministic_seed so response shape matches theirs.

Dina: Cool. Recap owners: Omar pricing/POC plan, Teja security/KMS/q, Liam facade PR, Dina legal/customer comms. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :rocket:
